checkpoint_cohort: All four final-epoch new_nvidia native checkpoints from accuracy-20261024; no best-score selection
common_assets: Prepare once on NVIDIA in a fresh process per model; transfer identical weight and real-data CPU tensor files to MetaX with SHA256 verification

inference.metrics: Original UP dataset evaluators on all frozen held-out batches; also compare raw semantic output tensors and within-device repeats

gradients.batch_positions: First, second and last batch in the original training loader, deduplicated if the loader has two batches
gradients.state: Reload identical parameters and buffers, clear gradients and restore CPU/CUDA/NumPy/Python RNG before every trial
gradients.scope: Within-vendor forward/backward repeatability at fixed inputs/state/RNG, not complete training accuracy or convergence

not_a_literal_reference_reproduction: Use matched UP FP32 policy, data, models and weights; borrow inference/state control and warn-only configuration, not the reference benchmark scores, AMP recipe or entire library implementation
failure_policy: Preserve every planned failure/warning. Execution completion, repeatability, tolerance and task metric equality are separate outcomes. Strict unsupported operators must fail without rewriting the model or silently retrying
